se_backend.name: sefanogan_es_reference
se_backend.provenance_requirement: Every SE run must prove exact checkpoint and metadata SHA256 identity at runtime

ae_backend.name: alfresco_ae_v1
ae_backend.provenance_requirement: Every AE run must record exact backend name and threshold

source_baseline.policy: All runs within the formal experiment must execute from the same git commit SHA
source_baseline.determination: Human decision required: which commit becomes the formal experiment baseline?
options: Current HEAD at protocol freeze time
Phase-3 final commit (if no source changes are needed)
A new commit that includes only protocol/documentation (no fuzzer/harness changes)
source_baseline.recording: Every run manifest must record the exact git commit SHA it executed from

target_configuration.target_identity: Formal experiment must freeze exact target endpoint, host, and configuration
target_configuration.target_baseline_reset: Between every AE/SE pair, the target's security_state baseline must be reset to ensure both runs start from identical coverage baseline
target_configuration.reset_validation: Every run manifest must confirm baseline reset occurred and security_state_new_total started at 0

testcase_budget.formal_experiment_value: Human decision required: keep MAX_TEST_CASES=5 or increase?
testcase_budget.constraint: Must be identical within every AE/SE pair

time_budget.formal_experiment_value: Human decision required: keep TIME_BUDGET=60 or increase?
time_budget.constraint: Must be identical within every AE/SE pair

execution_budget.budget_policy: If increasing budget from Phase-3 values, do NOT combine Phase-3 observations with formal study observations as if budgets were identical

seed_freeze.authority: Seeds must be frozen before first real run via deterministic generation procedure
seed_freeze.recording: Every run manifest must record which seed from the frozen seed list was used

order_freeze.authority: Within-pair execution order (AE-first vs SE-first, or randomization plan) must be frozen before first real run
order_freeze.recording: Every run manifest must record execution order within the pair

run_manifest_contract.description: Every run (AE or SE) must emit a JSON manifest containing all required provenance fields
run_manifest_contract.readback_requirement: All emitted JSON files must be readable and parseable by the validation script

evidence_reconciliation.trace_stats_reconciliation: Trace file contents must reconcile with reported counters (body_score_rpc_ok, trace_invocations, etc.)
evidence_reconciliation.artifact_contract: All required artifact files must be present, parseable, and internally consistent
evidence_reconciliation.readback: All emitted files must be re-readable after the run completes

interruption_policy.during_run: Invalidates the run; the paired block containing that run is excluded
interruption_policy.recording: Every run manifest must record whether the run was interrupted

model_artifact_authority.policy: Repo-local leftover model files are NOT authority
model_artifact_authority.requirement: The runtime must prove exact artifact identity for every SE run by computing SHA256 of the loaded checkpoint and metadata files
model_artifact_authority.validation: Run manifest must record computed SHA256 values, not just file paths

reproducibility_commitment.protocol_version: This protocol design version (frozen before execution)
reproducibility_commitment.phase3_freeze: Phase-3 evidence package with SHA256 commitment (binds formal study to validated pilot)
reproducibility_commitment.seed_list: Frozen seed list with SHA256 commitment
reproducibility_commitment.analysis_script: Frozen analysis code with git SHA
reproducibility_commitment.all_run_manifests: Every run manifest with SHA256 commitment
reproducibility_commitment.final_evidence_package: Complete formal study evidence package with SHA256 commitment

human_decisions_required: H_BASELINE: Which git commit becomes the formal experiment source baseline?
notes: This contract binds the formal experiment to the frozen Phase-3 artifacts and procedures.
All provenance fields are required for reproducibility.
SE runs must prove exact canonical model identity at runtime.
AE runs must record exact configuration identity.
No run is valid without a complete provenance chain.
